name: Ingrid of Sweden
contribution: Queen of Denmark from 20 April 1947 to 14 January 1972 as the wife of King Frederik IX.
legacy: As queen, this person reformed the traditions of Danish court life, abolished many old-fashioned customs at court and created a more relaxed atmosphere at official receptions

checks.lead: Ingrid (Ingrid Victoria Sofia Louisa Margareta; 28 March 1910 – 7 November 2000) was Queen of Denmark from 20 April 1947 to 14 January 1972 as the wife of King Frederik IX.
